rationale: Both retry on TransientError with errors.As, defer Close so it runs after Defrob, and recover from panics in Frob. B handles the recovered value more idiomatically and more robustly. A type switch covers the FrobError case (Defrob, then return the error), any other error, and a default that re-panics on panic values that are not errors. A silently swallows a non-error panic and returns nil, which hides failures. B also returns nil explicitly at the end, which makes the success path clear. A returns its named err, which only works because err happens to be nil after the open loop. B's use of plain 'defer resource.Close()' is simpler than A's wrapper closure. Overall B is clearer and more correct beyond the tests.
